department: Revenue (Swarna Gramam and Swarna Wardu services)

eligibility.who: AP resident; applying on the applicant's own income or a parent's income
eligibility.income_limit_note: To confirm. Video narrator mentioned rural ~Rs 1.2 lakh, urban ~Rs 1.44 lakh (scholarship context); not verified.

details_asked: Income from land, business, buildings, labour, spouse salary, other sources

documents.name: Filled income self-declaration form
documents.why: Your declared income sources and total
documents.if_missing: Download the official form from the Downloads menu of the AP Seva or MeeSeva portal

documents.name: Ration card / SPDC card / Aadhaar card copy
IT return, pay slip or other income proof

upload_rules: PDF format, maximum 1 MB per file (portal note)
steps: Open the AP Seva portal and log in as a citizen
Go to Application Submission, then Revenue, then Income Certificate
Basic Details tab: Aadhaar pre-fill, fill details, verify mobile number
Application Form tab: choose the purpose, applicant or parent income, enter income details
Upload the documents (PDF, up to 1 MB each)
Tick the consent boxes and click Show Payment
Application goes to the mandal revenue office
Track status on the portal home page with your Aadhaar or service request number, then download the certificate

fee.mode: Online (card, net banking, UPI, BHIM via BillDesk)
fee.note: Seen on the payment screen in a 2026 video; an older page said Rs 35 at MeeSeva centres. Confirm.

validity_note: To confirm. A sample EWS certificate said 'Valid for the year 2024-2025'; an older guide said one year.
